author: China Insights
description:
For years, platforms like Futu and Tiger Brokers offered Chinese investors a simple way to access overseas markets. But that era may now be coming to an end.

Following a coordinated regulatory action involving multiple Chinese agencies, the two companies were hit with massive penalties and strict restrictions. At the same time, political pressure in the United States has added another layer of uncertainty for Chinese-linked financial firms listed abroad.

In this episode, we trace the rise of cross-border investing platforms, how they became popular among China’s middle class, and why regulators are now moving aggressively against them. More importantly, we examine what these developments could mean for ordinary investors caught between tightening controls and growing geopolitical tensions.

title: China’s Crackdown on Futu & Tiger: What It Means for Millions of Investors    I China Insights
